description: Move a task from the current project to another project you own. Reassigns the task a fresh id in the target (collision-free) and carries its build reports, comments, and history with it; the cycle assignment is cleared so it lands in the target project's backlog. You must own (or have write access to) BOTH projects. Destructive-ish and cross-project, so it requires confirm=true — without it you get a preview only. Does not call the Anthropic API.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the move. Omit (or false) to get a preview of what would happen.

target_project.description: The destination project — its slug (e.g. "papi-ui") or UUID. Must be a project you own.

name: task_move
